title: euphrasia gibbsiae subsp. kingii
intro: Euphrasia gibbsiae subsp. kingii, commonly known as Himalayan eye-bright, is a flowering plant species within the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential in treating eye disorders, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Euphrasia gibbsiae subsp. kingii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as conjunctivitis, bronchitis, and gastritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and iridoids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
